profile.headline: Software Engineer | open source enthusiast | Python, C, JS, Ruby, Bash, SQL, Linux
profile.summary:
Self-taught developer. Long-time Linux user, open source contributor, passionate about free/libre/open-source software. I use GitHub extensively for my personal workflow. Projects include: a data visualization web app incorporating Django, Seaborn, and a private database API; a Discord chat bot supported by a PostgreSQL database; assemblers and interpreters for esoteric languages (HACK, befunge-93); and automation scripts using Google Sheets API, Bash, etc.

Most comfortable building with Python and C. Also experienced with Ruby, JavaScript, Bash. Other technologies used for various projects include Heroku, Docker, and Vim. Excited to learn more about machine learning, low-level programming (experience through nand2tetris curriculum), and embedded software development.
